---
## Size
Qwen Image 2.1 has native 2K (2048*2048) support for direct output.

- resolution is a total pixel budget (not width or height). Aspect ratio is preserved.
- Official default is 1024. The model supports up to 2048.
- Output size comes from ResolutionSelector (width/height) and Longestside to calc. Or follows image_1. Extra refs can differ in size or aspect.
- custom_size off: canvas comes from the encode latent (image_1).
- custom_size on: use ResolutionSelector width/height. Keep it close to the resized image_1 size, or the edit can shift.

## Reference images
- Up to 10 reference images (image_1 to image_10).
- Mention them in the prompt as `<image1>`, `<image2>`, ...
- image_1 is the edit target. The rest are references.

## Parameters

- prompt: what to generate. For RGBA, see Note: transparent. Edit instruction. Use `<image1>` ... `<image10>`.
- negative_prompt: unused while cfg is 1.
- cfg: keep 1 for the Qwen Image 2.1 official path. Raise it only if you use a negative prompt.

## Transparent Image

To generate a transparent image, wrap the prompt like this and replace the middle with the subject:

```
This is an RGBA format image with transparency. `[your description]`. The image has an alpha channel and a transparent background.
```
Save as PNG to keep the alpha channel.

Create a professional multi-angle reference sheet of the character based on the <images 1>. 
Generate one single composite image featuring a structured layout with four vertical columns, even spacing, and thin panel borders. Arrange the composition into two horizontal rows. Top row: four full-body standing views placed side-by-side in this order: front view, left profile view (facing left), right profile view (facing right), back view. Bottom row: four highly detailed close-up portraits aligned beneath the full-body row in this order: front portrait, left profile portrait (facing left), right profile portrait (facing right), back portrait. Maintain perfect identity consistency across every panel. Neutral studio lighting, clean solid grey background, flat lighting, clean silhouettes, consistent alignment, 8K resolution, no text, no watermarks.
